faqs.question: How does polyaspartic epoxy hold up against Ontario winter road salt?
faqs.answer: Unlike hardware-store epoxy paint kits that peel after one winter, our system utilizes a mechanical diamond grind bond (CSP 3) and an industrial aliphatic polyaspartic topcoat. Road salt brine and slush cannot penetrate the chemical cross-links.

faqs.question: Can I park my vehicle on it without hot-tire pickup?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our polyaspartic topcoats withstand heat ratings up to 150°C. Hot tires coming off the QEW or Red Hill Valley Parkway will never soften, lift, or delaminate our coatings.

faqs.question: How long does installation take?
faqs.answer: Most standard 2-car and 3-car residential garages are completed in just 1 to 2 days. You can walk on the floor within 6 to 8 hours and park your vehicles after 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.question: Do you repair existing pitted, salt-damaged, or cracked concrete?
faqs.answer: Yes! Preparation is 80% of a lasting floor. We diamond-grind away all surface contaminants, then fill and stitch every crack and salt-pitted crater with ultra-fast curing polyurea mender before coating.

faqs.question: What warranty comes with Purest Epoxy floors?
faqs.answer: Kyle backs all residential polyaspartic garage installations with a comprehensive 15-year adhesion and anti-peeling warranty.

faqs.question: What causes the majority of roof leaks in Ontario homes?
faqs.answer: Over 70% of leaks occur around vent pipes, skylights, chimneys, or in valleys due to dried rubber gaskets, failed caulking, or winter ice damming where frozen water pushes under shingles.

faqs.question: Do you lay new shingles over old ones (roof-over)?

faqs.question: How do you protect my driveway, landscaping, and pets?
faqs.answer: We set up heavy tarp chutes, protect flowerbeds with plywood shields, and run high-powered industrial magnetic sweepers across your driveway, lawn, and sidewalks 3 times before departing.

faqs.question: Are your roof replacements backed by warranty?
faqs.answer: Yes. You receive a 50-year manufacturer material warranty on our architectural shingles and a dedicated 15-year Diamond Roof workmanship guarantee.

faqs.question: How does polyaspartic hold up on outdoor porches against Ontario sun and snow?
faqs.answer: Unlike standard epoxy which quickly turns yellow and chalky under direct UV rays, our porch systems use 100% aliphatic polyaspartic topcoats. They are completely UV-stable, maintain non-slip traction even when wet, and resist freeze-thaw spalling from winter road salt.

faqs.question: How do custom epoxy countertops compare to quartz or granite?
faqs.answer: Our resin countertops are poured seamlessly with zero grout lines or seams to harbor bacteria. They are heat-resistant up to 250°C, 100% food-safe, stain-proof against wine and oils, and can be poured directly over existing laminate, quartz, or wood at 40%–60% lower cost than full demolition.

faqs.question: Can you park hot vehicle tires on your garage floors without peeling?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our industrial polyaspartic topcoat has a heat rating up to 150°C. Scorching summer tires coming directly off Highway 401 or Highway 403 will never cause hot-tire pickup, softening, or delamination.

faqs.question: How long does a typical porch or garage installation take?
faqs.answer: Most 2-car garages and front porches are completed in just 1 to 2 days. The rapid-cure polyaspartic topcoat is ready for foot traffic in 6 to 8 hours and vehicle parking after 24 to 48 hours.

faqs.question: What warranty does LAYR EPOXY provide?
faqs.answer: We stand behind our preparation and materials with a written 15-year adhesion and anti-delamination warranty on all residential garage and porch installations in Mississauga.
